description: Java class implementing a REST controller for managing notes, providing CRUD endpoints via Spring Boot annotations.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST API controller for notes with endpoints for create, read, update, delete.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note, returning 201 with the created note.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a note by ID.
